exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.remarks: Exchange rate at time of inventory usage shipped.

expreceiptdate.title: Shipmentnum
expreceiptdate.remarks: The expected date for the items to be received.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the item. To enter more information, click the Long Description push button.

shipmentdate.title: Shipment Date
shipmentdate.remarks: The date the items were shipped. The shipment date is set when you commence the shipping process by changing the status of the inventory record to SHIPPED.

currencycode.title: Currency
currencycode.remarks: Identifies the currency inventory usage is in.

invusenum.title: Usage
invusenum.remarks: The number associated with the inventory usage.

autosplit.title: AUTOSPLIT
autosplit.remarks: Autosplit the use line records across multiple bins/lots.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site of the organization associated with the inventory. The site information comes from the default insert site in the user's profile, which also contains information about the organization and storeroom.

invowner.title: Inventory Owner
invowner.remarks: The person responsible for the inventory.

fromstoreloc.title: From Location
fromstoreloc.remarks: The storeroom where the item is stocked. The storeroom information defaults from the user profile, which also contains information about the site and organization.

shipto.title: Ship To
shipto.remarks: The company or division where the items are to be shipped.

shipmentnum.title: Shipment
shipmentnum.remarks: The shipment document reference number provided by supplier.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: The person who last changed the record.

changedate.title: Changed Date
changedate.remarks: The date the record was last changed.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization associated with the inventory.

statusdate.title: Status Change Date
statusdate.remarks: The date the status was last changed.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.remarks: The receipt status of the inventory usage record. The receipt status applies only to inventory records that have been shipped.

autocreated.title: Auto Created
autocreated.remarks: Indicates whether the Inventory Usage document is automatically created as a result of WorkOrder/PO/MR approval.

carrier.title: Shipmentnum
carrier.remarks: The transportation agency that is responsible for delivering the shipment.

statusiface.title: Status Changed
statusiface.remarks: Indicates whether the status has changed. This is used by the application to drive other business rules.

packingslipnum.title: Shipmentnum
packingslipnum.remarks: The packing slip number for the shipment.

shiptoattn.title: Attention of
shiptoattn.remarks: The person to whom the inventory items are being shipped.

usetype.title: Usage Type
usetype.remarks: The type of usage that is contained in the record. The value in this field is filled based on the usage line types entered for the record. By default, the field is set to MIXED.

np_statusmemo.title: Change Status Memo
np_statusmemo.remarks: Status change memo, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the inventory usage record.
